about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: From XPENG marketing to AI builder
about.status: Open to AI PM roles · 2026 Cohort
about.bio1: I'm a 2026 AI Product Manager candidate with a Master's in Human-Computer Interaction from the University of Queensland. Before grad school, I led North China marketing operations at XPENG Motors for two years.
about.bio2: Today I run a one-person AI studio out of Hohhot — shipping production agents on Coze and Dify, benchmarking five frontier models head-to-head, and turning the chaos of solo work into a three-tier multi-agent system I use every day.
about.bio3: My core belief: the best AI PMs are also AI builders. Every project on this site was scoped, prototyped, shipped, and dog-fooded by me.

items.title: Coze · Job Topic Inspiration Bot
items.description: A three-agent Coze workflow that turns a target role into a full content package — topic ideas, post outlines, and cover copy — for AI-PM job seekers.

items.title: Dify · AI Resume Optimizer
items.description: Upload a resume PDF and paste a JD — the workflow parses both, scores the fit across five dimensions, and drafts a tailored cover letter in under 30s.

items.title: Five-Model Benchmark Dashboard
items.description: A public Notion dashboard comparing Claude / GPT / Gemini / MiniMax / DeepSeek across six dimensions, with cost-per-task and one real story per model.

items.title: Nova · Three-Tier Agent System
items.description: My personal AI ops: a Minimax-powered secretary (Nova) that triages tasks, a HealthBot that runs my training plan, and Claude Code that handles strategy and code.

items.title: Smart Library Thermal-Perception System
items.description: UQ HCI capstone (HD 7/7). An IoT system that learns each reader's thermal comfort profile and auto-adjusts zone HVAC — paired with a mobile companion app.

items.title: Memory Future Simulator
items.description: Team lead, 6-person Sprint. A speculative-design web simulator exploring how AI-generated future memories would reshape decision-making today.
